sql_used:
SELECT a.ArtistId, a.Name, COUNT(al.AlbumId) AS album_count,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(al.AlbumId) DESC) AS rnk
FROM Artist a
LEFT JOIN Album al USING (ArtistId)
GROUP BY a.ArtistId, a.Name
ORDER BY album_count DESC, a.Name
LIMIT 10;
assumptions: "Most albums" is interpreted as the count of Album rows associated with each Artist in the Album table.
